uncertaintyMeaning: Qualitative plausible phonetic-ownership ranges, not statistical confidence intervals, waveform threshold errors, or 1 ms accuracy claims. Retained points are unresolved choices, not certified leading edges.
filterAndSeparationLimits: 2048-sample Hann windows have ±23.22 ms sample support about their plotted centers; 512-sample windows have ±5.80 ms. HTDemucs is noncausal and may smear edges or retain accompaniment. Source/stem clock lag measured at zero does not remove those limits. Original mix is authority. High-pitched harmonic ridges are not automatically F1/F2 estimates.
